tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin sreg dbus kyi nyi 'od bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin sreg bya tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sbyor ba drug las/ dang po ni thab dkar po mtho gang zlum po'i dbus su gru gsum zlum skor gyi phyi rol du zlum skor sor bzhi pa gnyis kyi phyi mar rdor 'phreng / zlum skor gsum gyi phyir sor bzhi gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ de'i phyir sor do gru bzhi dbus kyi gru gsum na 'bru'am tshon sngon gyi chom bu/ thab nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor yang 'bru'am tshon dmar gyi tshom bu dang ting lo che ba bzhag go /gnyis pa bud shing ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing ngam/ srog chags med pa'i lci bas zlum skor gnyis pa'i steng dbyibs/ de ltar mtho gang tshad du brtsigs/ gsum pa me ni/ rdo lcags gtsub pa ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gam/ 'o ma can gyi shing gtsub pa'o/ /bzhi ba rdzas ni/ mchod gtor bsregs rdzas ku sha'i chun po brgyad rnams so/ /lnga pa bsham thab ni/ rang 'jig rten pa'i shar lho gdan gyi drung du/ rang g.yon thab/ g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ de'i rgyab phud gtor sman raka dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor ma/ rang g.yas thab g.yon nas yam shing mar til/ zas mchog so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dur wa/ ku sha rnams snod dang bso chas bcas/ rang gi mdun du bsang chu 'thor yab/ rdor dril bar dgang blugs kha sbyar/ nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor nas/ me yol gang dang chu ril baṃ gyis mtshan pa bshams nas rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi gtor ro/ /drug pa sgrub po ni/ rang nyid khrus byas gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan sdig pa sogs zhi ba'i bsam pas shar lta skyil krung gis 'dug pa ste sbyor ba'o/ /dngos gzhi la drug las/

dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi me sbar zhing shin tu 'bar bar bsam/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsangs ba ni/ bsang chu la nang mchod rdo rje'i rtses gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsangs chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad thams cad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags nyer gcig bzlas/ de nas thab dang yo byad rnams la ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis bsangs chu gtor nas 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thog pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐ nas/ bi pu ra ya hūm̐ gi bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ yam shing / oṃ shrī swāhā/ mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā 'bru/ oṃ oṃ swāhā rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ rdzas thams cad sbyongs/ bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ yang thab la bsangs chu gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha sogs dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po/

rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing / phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing rtsig pa dang bcas par gyur/ par bsam/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug dang / sma ra'i ag tshom can/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros te shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang lag pa gnyis kyis mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+ne ye ma hā te dza sarba kā ma/ pra sa dha ka ma hā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi/ di wi dza satwa/ ma gṛ hi twa sarba satwār+tha kri twa ā hūm̐ ti at+mi pan+ti he two bha wa pad+ma kā ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dz+wa la ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃn bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ tri sh+ya ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥsogs kyi dgug gzhug bya/

slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsangs chu gtor nas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes pas ku sha'i rtse mo g.yas bskor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul/ de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong du me sbar ba bshad kyang spor lde sbar nas thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing kī la ya brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas thab kyi nang gi ting lo la sbar zhing / de nas yam shing gzhan dang bcas me legs par 'bar du bcug mar dgang blugs gsum dang dz+wa la'i sngags kyis gso de nas/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / dgang blugs kyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā/ oṃ ag+na dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pā ri wā ra oṃ aḥhūm̐/

'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍāk+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod skabs 'dir me pra brtag pa ni mdor bsdu na/ kha dog dkar zhing snum pa sgra cung zad dang bcas par du ba chung ba zhi ba'i las la dga' 'os/ du ba che ba me stag 'phro pa ni bgegs dang bcas pa yin pas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsangs chu phyogs kun tu gtor zhing bgegs zhi bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bsreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ thog mar yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes bdun gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar dang / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pas til lam yungs dkar dang / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zhes zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang / oṃ badz+ri bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba can dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras dang / oṃ ma hā be ga ye swāhā/ nas dang / oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swāhā/ gro dang / oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma dang / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba dang / oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i mthar gong ltar gyi spel tshig sbyor/ der bsangs chu nas/ me nang du cung zad blugs la/ oṃ prok+ṣa naṃ añts+ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas bsang gtor dang / zhabs bsil phul/ mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar ma reg par thab nang du blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/

drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar me gso ba'i phyir bud shing rtsig pa dang / mchod pa sreg rdzas rnams cung zad gsos la/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / oṃ ma hā shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ sogs kyis me dang thab bsangs sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ rkyen thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ keṃ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas/ zhes sogs nas/ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus 'od du zhu nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhes sogs dang / dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /zhes sogs nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ dap+ti tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen zhes sogs nas/ 'khyud par bzhugs bar/ 'di'i sogs khongs rnams sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni bsdu rgya se gol dang / oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ karma kro ti shwa ri āḥbar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas byon zan dbul ba ni/ kī la ya'i rjes su/ ag+ne sogs spel tshig dang bcas lan bdun dbul/ slar yang mchod rdzas dang bsregs rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin brlabs/ sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig sngags bcas dang / byang chub mchog tu sogs kyis nang mchod/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen sogs kyis gsang mchod/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas sogs kyis de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/

dam tshig chen po'i sogs gdabs kha dang pos bsgral mchod/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /sogs kyis rak+ta'i mchod pa/ nga ni za byed chen po sogs khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa/ bla med mchog gi sogs gtor ma'i mchod pa/ gru gsum mthing nag sh+lau ka gcig gi bstod pa rnams bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin no/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim gong bzhin la/ sngags rnams kī la ya 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su til yungs dkar gang rigs la bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin zhing spel tshig bkod ltar bya/ skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang mar ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ sreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya rtsa re 'bul dgos par dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yong ba'i skabs su gang bab re phul mthar mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun/ spel tshig gong ltar bya/ de nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin dang dkar bdud phur srung la gtor bsngo byas la/ de nas/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyis thabs kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ lag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba blangs la dpral bar rig go /dngos gzhi'o/ /rjes la drug las/ dang po me lha mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod la/ me lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur par bsam/ de nas bsregs rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i spel tshig dang bcas bdun re 'bul/ slar yang mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun phul la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gnyis pa gtor ma btang ba ni/

me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod gong bzhin dang / bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ gsum pa 'dod don zhu ba ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba'o/ /bzhi pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ prok+ṣa naṃ añtsa ma ni pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ bsangs gtor dang zhabs bsil phul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrub kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ag+na ye ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes dang / dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bkyed do/ /me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /lnga pa lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis kha bskang / oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sogs kyis go cha bkod pa dang / rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /drug pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ de lta bu'i sbyin sreg gi dus 'dir me'i dkyil mi dkrug phus mi gdab/ me ma shi bar g.yo 'gul mi byed/ bud shing dang yam shing sogs bsregs rdzas rnams la mi 'gom/ me lha drang srong yin pas gtsang sbra la gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i ngag 'don kha skongs dgos pa rnams so/

/'di'i bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed la sngags 'chang chen po'i mchan dang / dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor chog bzhin no/ /kī la bzhi 'bum yin na sbyin sreg bzhi khri ste nyin gsum la cho ga bzhi ste/ tshugs grol gnyis la re re dang / bar mar snga chog dgong chog la kī la ya stong phrag re'i mtshams su 'bul tshan bcu gnyis re byas pa bcu byas pas stabs bde bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rdo rje phur pa'i sbyin sreg bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la sbyar ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin sreg PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
